title: Junior Full Stack Developer
description: Hakkımızda Biz, köpekler için her gün taze ve sağlıklı yemekler hazırlayan ve onlar için en doğru beslenme planlarını oluşturmaya çalışan bir markayız. Bu süreci yönetirken arka planda teknolojiyi, operasyonu ve veri analitiğini bir arada yürütüyoruz. Her geçen gün büyüyen ve gelişen ekibimizde; öğrenmeye ve gelişime açık, analitik düşünce yapısına sahip ve takım çalışmasına yatkın bir Junior Full Stack Developer arıyoruz. Yeni fikirlerin rahatlıkla paylaşılabildiği ve yeni teknolojileri deneyimleyebileceğin geniş bir gelişim alanına sahip bir çalışma ortamımız var. Web teknolojilerinde kendini geliştirerek fark yaratırken, bir yandan köpek dostlarımızın daha sağlıklı yaşamasına katkı sağlamak istersen başvurunu bekliyoruz. İş Tanımı Şirket bünyesindeki web uygulamalarının ve yazılım projelerinin uçtan uca (Full Stack) tasarımı, geliştirilmesi ve sürdürülebilirliği süreçlerinde aktif rol almak, İş analizinden gelen gereksinimleri derinlemesine analiz ederek ölçeklenebilir, güvenli ve performanslı yazılım çözümleri üretmek, Yazılım mimarisi standartlarına uygun, okunabilir, sürdürülebilir ve temiz kod prensiplerine sadık kalarak geliştirme yapmak, Mevcut süreç ve ürünlerin iyileştirilmesinde proaktif davranarak yenilikçi çözüm önerileri getirmek, Sektör trendlerini ve yeni nesil teknolojileri araştırarak projelerin modernizasyonuna ve ekibin teknik gelişimine katkı sağlamak. Genel Nitelikler Laravel frameworkü ile nesne yönelimli programlama (OOP) ve web uygulamaları geliştirme konusunda deneyimli, İlişkisel veritabanları (SQL) ve anahtar-değer (Key-Value) tabanlı veritabanı yapıları (Redis vb.) konusunda bilgi veya tecrübe sahibi, Temel web teknolojilerine (HTML, CSS, JavaScript) iyi derecede hakim, İş gereksinimlerini doğru analiz ederek etkin çözümler üretebilen; planlı, sistematik ve koordinasyon yeteneği yüksek, Yenilikçi (inovatif) düşünme becerisine sahip, süreç ve ürün geliştirme aşamalarında inisiyatif alarak katma değer yaratabilen, Sürekli öğrenmeye açık, yeni teknolojileri ve sektör trendlerini yakından takip ederek hızla adapte olabilen, Güçlü iletişim becerilerine sahip, sorumluluk bilinci yüksek ve takım çalışmasına yatkın. Tercihen Bilgisayar Mühendisliği, Yazılım Mühendisliği, Bilgisayar Bilimleri veya ilgili bölümlerden lisans derecesine sahip, Git ile versiyon yönetimi süreçlerine ve modern iş akışlarına hakim veya deneyimli, Yazılım mimarilerine, temiz kod (Clean Code) prensiplerine ve en iyi uygulama yöntemlerine (Best Practices) meraklı ve bunları hayata geçirmeye istekli, Modern ön yüz (Frontend) framework’lerinden (React, Vue.js, Svelte, Angular vb.) en az birinde deneyim sahibi, DevOps süreçleri, araçları ve kültürü (CI/CD, Docker vb.) hakkında bilgi sahibi.

title: Software Engineer (Backend)
description: The digital entertainment and iGaming world is entering a new era, driven by rapidly evolving technology and changing user expectations. This shift demands not only strong brands, but also integrated structures capable of leading them under a unified strategy. This is the vision that inspired the creation of NGAMING. Established in 2026 under Doğan Online (DOL), NGAMING is a next-generation group structure bringing together leading brands in digital entertainment and iGaming under one shared mission and strategy. We built NGAMING to be integrated, sustainable, and collectively stronger, enabling brands to grow not individually, but together. Today, through Nesine, atyarışı.com and Liderform, we move forward not only with our individual achievements but as an integrated structure aligned around a common goal. The driving force behind this vision in technology and software is our company, D Yazılım Teknoloji A.Ş. Join a team full of life and become an essential player! Create groundbreaking projects, build new digital worlds, and make your mark! Surprise your competitors with strategic moves, inspire with your speed, and always pass the ball to your team! If you're looking for a tech-driven, innovative, and exciting career where every moment is full of energy and opportunity, you're in the right place. Join NGAMING — and rewrite the game! Full-of-Life Qualities Bachelor’s degree in Computer Engineering or related fields, Minimum 5+ years experience in software development, Solid knowledge of Asp.NET & Asp.NET Core, C#, MVC, Web API, REST and SOAP services on multi-layered and distributed architectures, Experience with JavaScript, Node.js knowledge is a plus, Experience using RDBMS (MsSQL) required and NOSQL (Mongo) is a plus, Strong knowledge on OOP, Design Patterns, Test Driven Development and Unit Testing, Knowledge of distributed message bus technologies like RabbitMQ, Kafka or similar, Knowledge and experience on Docker & Kubernetes is a plus, Experience in the implementation of microservice architectures, Able to successfully work in Scrum team environment, Strong communication, team working and problem-solving skills with a keen attention to detail. A Full Look on the Job Description As a scrum team member, you will be responsible for development and maintenance processes of software projects, Creating high quality code and writing maintainable unit tests, Continuously improving and applying technical skills on various platforms, Researching and developing new technologies, Build high performance backends that will reach millions of users. Full-of-Life Benefits: “Employee benefits” but it’s also known as “Full-of-Life Benefits” in the world of NGAMING🙂 Private health insurance with unlimited coverage extending to spouse and children, A multinet restaurant ticket, Transportation benefits on office working days, In addition to annual leave days, you have three Won’t Make It Today 🙂 days, which you can use whenever you like (we simply call this BAY 🙂) An additional one-day birthday leave to redeem on any day during your birthday week, Gift vouchers on holidays, Gifts on special occasions, including marriage and child birth, Shop as you wish throughout the year with gift transfers to your Digital Wallet! Follow NGAMING on LinkedIn to discover our high-spirited, full-of-life team! Bu ilan sebebiyle yapacağınız başvurular aracılığıyla toplanacak kişisel verileriniz veri sorumluları NGAMING markası grup şirketleri D Elektronik Şans Oyunları ve Yayıncılık A.Ş., 4 Race Teknoloji ve Yazılım A.Ş., D Yazılım Teknoloji A.Ş., Liderform At Yarışları Enformasyon Anonim Şirketi tarafından 6698 sayılı Kişisel Verilerin Korunması Kanunu ve ilgili mevzuat kapsamında iş başvuru süreçlerinin yürütülmesi amacıyla işlenecektir. Kişisel verilerinize ve haklarınıza ilişkin detaylı bilgi için lütfen Çalışan Adayı Aydınlatma Metnimizi inceleyiniz.

title: Full Stack Lead - Trading Platform
description: We are looking to hire a Full Stack lead – Trading Platform who will be responsible for leading the architecture, development, and delivery of a next-generation web and mobile financial trading platform for our client based in Turkey . This is a permanent role within the organization. The role sits within the Technology Department and reports directly to the Head of Engineering . We are looking for a passionate Full Stack Lead with experience in building scalable, secure, and high-performance financial applications. The ideal candidate should possess strong expertise in React, React Native, Node.js, PostgreSQL, cloud-native technologies, and microservices architecture, along with experience delivering real-time applications in a fast-paced environment. Key Responsibilities Lead the end-to-end technical design, development, and deployment of the trading platform across web and mobile channels. Define and own the platform architecture, ensuring scalability, security, and performance. Design and develop responsive web applications using React and TypeScript. Lead the development of React Native mobile applications for iOS and Android. Build and maintain backend services and APIs using Node.js and microservices architecture. Design, optimize, and manage PostgreSQL databases for high-volume transactional workloads. Implement real-time data streaming and event-driven solutions using WebSockets and messaging technologies. Manage cloud infrastructure and deployments across AWS, Azure, or GCP environments. Develop and maintain CI/CD pipelines and Infrastructure as Code solutions. Ensure adherence to security best practices, regulatory requirements, and software engineering standards. Mentor developers, conduct code reviews, and promote engineering excellence across the team. Collaborate closely with Product, QA, UX/UI, DevOps, and business stakeholders to deliver project objectives. Knowledge, Skills & Experience Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Information Technology, or a related discipline. Minimum 8 years of software development experience, including at least 3 years in a Lead or Senior Technical role. Expert-level experience with React, TypeScript, and React Native. Strong hands-on experience with Node.js, Express, NestJS, or similar backend frameworks. Deep understanding of microservices architecture and distributed systems. Strong PostgreSQL database design, optimization, and performance tuning experience. Hands-on experience with AWS, Azure, or GCP cloud platforms. Experience with Docker, Kubernetes, CI/CD pipelines, and Infrastructure as Code tools such as Terraform. Proven experience developing real-time applications using WebSockets, event streaming, or messaging technologies. Strong understanding of authentication, authorization, OAuth 2.0, JWT, and application security principles. Experience integrating with third-party APIs, financial systems, or trading platforms is highly preferred. Knowledge of Kafka, RabbitMQ, Redis, Elasticsearch, or similar technologies is advantage. Excellent communication, leadership, stakeholder management, and problem-solving skills. Availability Preference will be given to candidates available immediately or within 30 days of accepting the offer. We will review your job application within 7 working days. Should your profile fit the requirements of the role, a consultant from Edari will be in touch with you to gain a deeper understanding of your experience, discuss the role in more detail, and outline the next steps in the recruitment process.

title: React Native Developer - Next
description: At HubX we build mobile apps, used and loved by millions all around the world. We have a track record of building and growing mobile apps on various verticals that have reached over 600 million users across 6 continents and 190+ countries. We are looking for a talented “ React Native Developer” for the ”Next ” to join our team. As a talented " React Native Developer” you have plenty of opportunities at your fingertips. So, why should HubX be your next move? We offer you an opportunity to make a huge impact in the lives of millions of users through our products, and even the mobile app industry at large in the next years to come. Ownership is at the core of how we work. From day one, you’re trusted with real responsibility. Together with your team, you’re free to choose a direction, experiment boldly, fail fast, learn, and turn the next idea into something even better. We operate through 7 independent studios, each focused on building and scaling its own products with full end-to-end ownership. This studio model empowers small, cross-functional teams to move fast, make decisions autonomously, and turn ideas into global products. Next Next reimagines how ideas take shape. Through apps like Davinci, Tattoo AI, Wiser and Betterspeak, we build thoughtful, elegant tools and experiences that turn creativity into reality; whether as a visual or a new way of thinking. Every detail is designed to feel seamless yet empowering, helping you create with clarity, joy and control. X Culture: Do What You Love At HubX, we pride ourselves on fostering an environment of collaboration, creativity, and innovation. Our #XCulture is more than just a workplace ethos; it's a lifestyle. We believe passion drives success. At HubX, Do What You Love isn’t just a motto; it's the foundation of our work. Some of your responsibilities Create beautiful, pixel-perfect UIs across both mobile platforms that look and feel native. Leverage native APIs for deep integrations with both platforms. Work alongside our product owner and UI/UX designers to realize your shared vision. Write automated tests that give us the confidence to iterate quickly and ensure the product is of the highest quality Diagnose and fix bugs and performance bottlenecks Engage with the React Native community to report, request, and help implement critical software fixes Maintain a stable and current-when-possible React Native create an environment for our CI pipeline Stay current on the latest platform capabilities so that we know whats possible Practice Scrum with a great group of developers and product managers What we look for 2+ years experience in mobile application development Experience developing with React Native, Redux (Android/iOS Apps) Experience with popular React Native workflows JavaScript and TypeScript experience, including concepts like asynchronous programming, closures, types, and ES6 Good knowledge of CSS and HTML Experience with REST APIs and services Experience with unit testing Familiarity using Scrum/Agile development methodologies Teamwork skills with a problem-solving attitude Practical knowledge of agile software development methodologies Good command of written and spoken English The perks and benefits of working with us We would like you to focus on what you do best, we take care of the rest. Daily essentials: We provide commuting and meal support to make your workday easier. A brand new MacBook and a designed welcome kit. Wellbeing: We support your overall wellbeing with private medical insurance (TSS), HPV vaccination, Heltia membership, and for our women teammates critical women’s health coverage, and annual Beije membership. Gym Reimbursement: We support annual gym membership because we want you to be in tip-top shape psychically and mentally. A unique and top-notch office: Whether you're based in the heart of Istanbul's vibrant Maslak district or enjoying panoramic sunset views from the tallest building in Izmir, you'll work in thoughtfully designed spaces built for creativity and collaboration. Our office is also pet-friendly, because we believe great workdays include our furry friends too. Office fuel: Unlimited coffee from XPresso, a fully stocked kitchen with breakfast and snacks throughout the day, and our HubX Breakfast Club, where we come together regularly to start the day with good food and even better conversations. Learning & development: We support your continuous learning with an education budget and weekly Cambly speaking sessions. Team events that create lasting memories, including our traditional All Hands gatherings where the whole company comes together, as well as more humble celebrations and happy hours. Curious about our vibe? Take a look at our Instagram! Strong company culture: Our approach is built on open communication and teamwork, strengthened by our #XCulture and community-driven X clubs that bring people together around shared interests. X Community discounts: Being part of HubX comes with perks, enjoy exclusive discounts and more as a valued member of our community. HubX app memberships: As a HubX teammate, you enjoy complimentary premium access to HubX apps , so you can experience and benefit from the products we build every day. Birthday perks: to celebrate you, we offer a dedicated birthday leave along with a birthday gift voucher , so you can enjoy your special day your way. The Recruiting Process At HubX, we value transparency and efficiency. Here’s a glimpse into our streamlined recruitment process: Application Submission: Apply by submitting your CV, LinkedIn profile, or a brief introduction about yourself. People & Culture Interview: Engage in a conversation with our People & Culture team to discuss your background, aspirations, and how we align with each other’s goals. Case Study Assignment: Showcase your skills through a practical task related to the role. Technical Interview: Meet with your potential team lead for an in-depth review of your case study and technical expertise. Welcome Aboard!: If all goes well, we’re excited to extend an offer and welcome you to the team. Your personal data collected through your job applications will be processed by HubX in accordance with the Personal Data Protection Law No. 6698 ("KVKK") for the recruitment and evaluation. title: Freelance (Hourly) Full‑stack Developer (.NET Core + React.js)
description: Company Description Leptes is a software development company serving EU clients. We build modern web apps primarily on .NET Core, SQL Server, React and Next.js. Engagement & Location Type : Long‑term freelance / contractor (hourly) Hours : 30–40 h/week (flexible) with 3–4h overlap with CET Location : Remote (Turkey) Start : ASAP Compensation & Invoicing Rate : 15 €/Hour Including VAT (KDV Dahil olarak 15 Euro/Saat) Invoicing : Monthly (TR invoice required). Payments via bank transfer. What you’ll do Design, develop and maintain .NET 6–10 backend services and REST APIs. Build responsive UI with React (Hooks + Redux) and TypeScript; contribute to Next.js features (SSR/App Router, API routes, Auth.js/NextAuth). Work with Entity Framework Core and SQL Server (schema design, queries, tuning). Write clean, testable code; participate in code reviews and follow Git/CI/CD practices. Collaborate with PMs/designers, refine requirements, estimate tasks and deliver iteratively. Must‑haves 4+ years work experience as full-stack development 4+ years in .NET (C#, .NET 6–9, EF Core, .Net MVC). 2–4+ years building SPAs with React.js and 2+ years with TypeScript. Azure development environment (DevOps, Entra, BlobStorage, etc.) Solid SQL skills on MSSQL. Working English (B2+) for daily standups and async written communications Must be located in Türkiye Candidates must be able to issue invoices for their work. Candidates must attend to daily meetings with the Customer Nice to have Experience with testing (xUnit/Jest), performance profiling, and caching Next.js experience (SSR, App Router, API routes; Auth.js/NextAuth). Knowledge of Azure AI (Open AI, AI Foundry) DevOps basics (Docker, CI/CD). Legacy front‑end exposure (jQuery/AJAX) for maintenance cases. Security/GDPR awareness. Requirements 4+ years of work experience as a full-stack developer 4+ years of work experience with C# 2+ years of work experience with React.js Candidates must be able to issue invoices monthly
